category: constructed / statement order decided by hidden index tables (ORDER-2b)
transformation: loop distribution in the textual order
why: ku[i] = i-1: S2 reads the element of u that S1 wrote one iteration earlier; kv[i] = LEN_1D+i: S1 reads v elements nothing writes
protected_note: `pb_mix(nl)` changes a few input values between two repetitions of the `nl` loop, so the repetitions depend on each other and must run in order; the loop under study is the one inside it. `LEN_1D`, the length of the arrays, is set in the included header: 32000 in the default build, and up to 192000000 in the builds that verify the result.
